That split is unsafe: text resembling XML inside comments/CDATA/processing instructions or an unrelated wrapper can be re-consumed by later regex extraction, and the current attributes() helper can silently overwrite duplicate attributes or ignore malformed leftover attribute text. Replace raw-document record/fact regex extraction with one bounded structural tokenization/walk (custom first-party code is acceptable) that is the single authority for top-level records and direct-child/subtree facts. Only direct child СвЮЛ elements of the EGRUL root are legal records. Text inside comments, CDATA and processing instructions is never reinterpreted as markup/records/facts. DTD/ENTITY remain forbidden. Attribute syntax must be fully consumed: duplicate attribute names, bare/unquoted/partially parsed attributes, malformed entity references, and XML-invalid character/entity values fail closed instead of last-write-wins/ignore. If an XML declaration is present, an encoding declaration inconsistent with the accepted windows-1251 transport fails closed; parser must not treat the declaration itself as transport authentication. Singular blocks duplicated ambiguously fail closed; repeatable facts remain deterministic.
